culture-and-protocol.dress_and_conduct: You are a guest on private land; each of the 12 villages is autonomous and sets its own rules. Long pants or a skirt are favoured over shorts at ceremonies.
culture-and-protocol.sacred_or_restricted_places: No photographing, recording, sketching or note-taking in and around the villages, especially at ceremonies. Not all ceremonies are public: check signs or ask locally; stay out of kivas unless invited and stay on the edge of dances. Ask village community development offices which ceremonies are open.
culture-and-protocol.note: The Hopi Tribe's own site was not read in full; rules are from ITCA and hopi.org.
